standard_prerequisites.name: Splitting of simplicial groups
standard_prerequisites.use: Each simplicial group Mor_A(A, U) is canonically split by Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-groups; the statement transports along these splittings.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2244-2255): for a simplicial object U in an abelian category A, the subobjects N(U_m) = intersection of the kernels of d^m_0, ..., d^m_{m-1} give a splitting, functorial in U.

Verification (proof lines 2257-2271): for each object A of A the simplicial group Mor_A(A, U) carries the canonical splitting of Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-groups, and its normalized summand is exactly Mor_A(A, N(U_m)); hence the splitting isomorphism of that lemma becomes an isomorphism after Mor_A(A, -) for every A, and the Yoneda lemma promotes it to an isomorphism of simplicial objects of A, natural in A and U.
proof_roadmap: Embed the problem into simplicial groups via the functors Mor_A(A, -).
Transport the canonical splitting of Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-groups.
Check the normalized summand computes as the kernel intersection; conclude by Yoneda.
difficulty_reason: Normalization splitting (statement 2244-2255, proof 2257-2271): the mechanism is the Mor-embedding into the registered Lemma lemma-splitting-simplicial-groups plus the identification Mor_A(A, ker d) = ker Mor_A(A, d) and a Yoneda finish; each step is a named tool, the functoriality claim is carried by the naturality in A. H3.
